name: Management craft
description: The day-to-day practice of managing engineers: one-to-ones, feedback, delegation, hiring and running a team.

name: Organizational design
description: How teams are sized, structured and connected, and how those structures shape the work.

name: Leadership progression
description: How the job changes as a leader moves from individual contributor to managing teams, managers and organizations.

name: Team culture
description: The human and environmental conditions that let a team do good work together.

name: Engineering excellence
description: Technical practices and feedback loops that keep software easy and safe to change.

name: Trust and accountability
description: How trust, healthy conflict and mutual accountability let a team commit to shared results.

name: Motivation
description: What drives people to do their best work, and how incentives help or get in the way.

name: Feedback and coaching
description: Giving and receiving guidance that helps people grow.

name: Power and influence
description: How power, perception and politics work inside organizations, and how to engage with them ethically.

name: Scaling organizations
description: What changes, for structures and for leaders, as an engineering organization grows.

name: Delivery performance
description: How fast and how safely a team gets changes to users, and the capabilities that improve both.
